problems.mathematics_checked: Expanded the exact retarded acceleration kernel through c^−2, integrated products by parts with a regulator, and reconstructed electric dipole, magnetic dipole and traceless quadrupole amplitudes.
problems.derivation_changes: Corrected the introductory Fourier-field factor to √(2π)cR under Jackson14.54; explicitly derived the retarded-time Jacobian and field-transform relation.
problems.notation_check: Gaussian radiation units, α=e²/(ℏc), positive frequency. Jackson's temporal transform has e^{+iωt}/√(2π) (p.674 Eq.14.54); the endpoint J integral is explicitly unnormalized. dI/dω is energy per angular frequency, ε=ℏω is photon energy, dN/dε=(dI/dω)/(ℏε), and dχ/dω is impact-integrated radiated energy. Screening α in15.9 is separately distinguished from α_fs.
problems.remaining_limitations: Low-velocity and small phase-displacement expansion; radiation formula itself is unchanged. Convergence factors are needed for asymptotically uniform trajectories.
